LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkOverflowTooltip: The network is over capacity. Stored hemogel is preserved, but new production is blocked until the reserve falls below capacity.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkFoundingDescription: Stop the flesh moon above an unoccupied surface tile or your colony and found the first outpost. Over an empty tile, the moon lowers a feeding umbilicus automatically; consuming a colony requires an open umbilicus passage. The consumed map is permanently lost. Cost: {0} hemogel from the moon's reserve.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkCancelOrderWarning: Cancel this capture order? The paid {0} hemogel will not be refunded.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkOutpostCreated: A flesh outpost has grown on world tile {0}.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTerritoryEnterDesc: Enter flesh-covered territory and open its temporary map. A permanent settlement cannot be founded here.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTerritoryTemporaryMapInspect: Temporary map: anything that does not leave with the caravan collapses along with it.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTerritoryCaravanDepartedWarning: The caravan has left: this temporary map collapses and everything still on it is lost.
LanguageData.FB_FirstOutpostConvertPlayerMapWarning: Absorb this location and found the first flesh outpost for {0} Moon hemogel? All {1} eligible colonists, prisoners, animals, and controlled fleshbeasts will be evacuated to the Moon. Local hemogel will be transferred in full and existing flesh structures and terrain will return {2} hemogel. All other buildings, items, and map contents will be destroyed without payment. This location will be permanently lost, and you will not be able to return to this world tile.
LanguageData.FB_MoonOutpostConsumeMapWarning: Consume this map and grow a flesh outpost here for {0} lunar hemogel? All eligible colonists, prisoners, animals, and controlled fleshbeasts ({1}) will be evacuated to the flesh moon. Local hemogel will be transferred in full, and flesh structures and terrain will return {2} hemogel. All other buildings, items, and map contents will be destroyed without compensation. The map will be permanently lost; the new outpost will contribute {3}% of its tile's output to the network.
LanguageData.FB_FirstOutpostConvertMoonMapUnavailable: The Moon map must be loaded and able to receive the evacuation.
LanguageData.FB_FirstOutpostConvertPhysicalChannelReq: Open an umbilicus passage to this map before consuming it to create a flesh outpost.
LanguageData.FB_MoonOutpostConsumeMapNotConsumable: The Moon can only consume its own anchor map, a flesh territory map, or one of your own settlements. This map belongs to someone else - break it with an assault or the standard umbilicus absorption instead.
LanguageData.FB_FirstOutpostConvertContainedPawns: Controlled living pawns outside the map, such as those in containers: {0}. Release them into this location before absorbing it.
LanguageData.FB_FirstOutpostConvertQuestBlocked: This map, tile, or one of its evacuees is involved in an active quest.
LanguageData.FB_FirstOutpostConvertArrivalSpaceUnavai: There is not enough safe free space on the Moon to evacuate every eligible pawn.
LanguageData.FB_FirstOutpostConvertFailed: Could not absorb the location and establish a flesh outpost.
LanguageData.FB_FirstOutpostConvertCompleted: Map consumed. Evacuated pawns: {0}. Flesh refund: {1} hemogel.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkExpansionDesc: Choose the active Moon or flesh outpost with the reserve bar, then spread flesh or grow another command center.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkNodeReserveTooltip: Shared reserve of this outpost's network: {0} hemogel. Click to choose another node.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkMoonReserveTooltip: The Moon strategic commands spend only its own internal reserve. Click to choose another node.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkSelectNodeTooltip: Click to select the Moon or a flesh outpost.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkCaptureDesc: Left-click to select an unoccupied tile bordering the flesh cover for absorption. Right-click to enable automatic expansion. The outpost spends hemogel from the shared network and waits for replenishment when supplies run low. Settlements must be taken in battle.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkCreateOutpostDesc: Grow an outpost on a flesh-covered tile in this network with no open local map. Cost: {0} hemogel. The outpost keeps part of its yield; {1}% reaches the network.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkFirstOutpostRequired: Found the first flesh outpost before creating a separate infection focus.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkMoonSeedDesc: Consume an unoccupied surface tile beneath the stationary flesh moon. The moon lowers a feeding umbilicus if needed. The cost depends on the terrain and is paid from the moon's hemogel reserve.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkMoonSeeded: The Moon has established a new flesh focus on world tile {0}.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkMoonCreateOutpostDesc: Grow an outpost beneath the stationary flesh moon for {0} hemogel from its reserve. The moon lowers a feeding umbilicus automatically; if a passage to a surface map is already open here, that map will be consumed. Uncovered land adds an absorption cost. The outpost's tile contributes {1}% of its output to the network.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkMoonCreateOutpostConf: Spend {0} hemogel from the flesh moon's reserve to grow an outpost here? It will contribute {1}% of its tile's output to the network. The outpost cannot be visited.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkMoonCreateOutpostWith: Cover this tile with flesh for {0} hemogel and grow an outpost for another {1}? Total cost from the flesh moon's reserve: {2}. The outpost will contribute {3}% of its tile's output to the network and cannot be visited.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkMoonOutpostCreated: The Moon has grown a flesh outpost on world tile {0}.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkMoonOutpostCreatedWit: The Moon covered world tile {0} with flesh and grew a new outpost on it.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkMoonAnchorRequired: First attach the moon's feeding umbilicus to the current world tile.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkMoonLowersUmbilicus: No umbilicus is attached here yet. During this operation, the moon will lower it to the selected tile and establish a feeding link.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkOutpostRenameDesc: Give this outpost its own name. It is shown on the world map, in the outpost list and in the network source menu.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkOutpostColorDesc: The color that marks this outpost on the world map and in lists. An outpost grown from it will start with the same color.
LanguageData.FB_OutpostManagementMainDesc: There is one main outpost for the whole colony. It comes first in outpost lists, in the planetary network source menu and in the pack's return menu. The planetary network, when opened with no outpost selected, shows this one. Click again to clear the mark.
LanguageData.FB_OutpostManagementColorResetDesc: Return the icon to the usual color of flesh structures.
LanguageData.FB_OutpostManagementColorCustomDesc: Open the color picker with a color wheel and a larger palette.
LanguageData.FB_OutpostOverviewCommandDesc: Open the overview of all outposts by network: names, colors, auto-capture, delivery routes, beast stock and a quick jump to any of them.
LanguageData.FB_OutpostOverviewAutoTip: Automatic capture of neighboring tiles by this outpost. The checkbox can be dragged across rows.
LanguageData.FB_OutpostOverviewRouteTip: The outpost this outpost sends its storage to by supply caravan. Click to pick from the list, or drag the button across rows to give other outposts the same route. A route that would close into a loop is skipped while dragging.
LanguageData.FB_OutpostOverviewAutoDispatchTip: Every {0} the outpost sends its accumulated storage along the delivery route on its own. Cannot be enabled without a route. The checkbox can be dragged across rows.
LanguageData.FB_OutpostOverviewAutoBeastsTip: Every {0} the outpost sends all of its beasts along the delivery route by supply caravan. Cannot be enabled without a route. The checkbox can be dragged across rows.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkOutpostTileHiveShare: The outpost has no hemogel upkeep. Its hive retains half of the host tile production; {0}% of that tile normal output reaches this network.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkOutpostsCategoryDesc: Grow outposts on unoccupied, flesh-covered tiles in the selected network. The tile must not have an open local map.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkProductionFacilitiesD: Grow extraction, defense, and travel organs on flesh-covered tiles in the selected network. These facilities cannot be visited.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkAmbushesDesc: Grow ambush camps on flesh-covered tiles in the selected network. They increase hemogel extraction and gather trophies, but cannot be visited.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkFacilitySourceRequire: Select a flesh outpost through the reserve bar before building planetary organs or ambush camps.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkBuildFacilityDesc: Grow a facility on an unoccupied, flesh-covered tile in this network with no open local map. Cost: {1} hemogel. Tile extraction multiplier: x{2}. Once built, this territory's local map cannot be opened.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkFacilityRequiresWater: This facility requires a covered land tile with a river, coast, lake or adjacent water.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAmbushCampNoRoutes: The camp is fully isolated from useful prey routes.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAmbushCampMoonNotAnchored: Attach the moon's feeding umbilicus to this camp's tile to send stored loot upward.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAmbushCampMoonMapUnavailable: The Moon interior map is not available.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAmbushCampDevGenerateLootDesc: Immediately roll one ambush haul for this camp, ignoring the usual timer and chance.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAmbushCampLootGenerated: The camp ambushed a caravan. Loot stacks added to storage: {0}.
LanguageData.FB_DevInstantCaptureDone: Dev: world tile {0} was captured instantly.
LanguageData.FB_DevFillNetworkHemogelDesc: Fill this network's hemogel reserve up to its capacity.
LanguageData.FB_DevDrainNetworkHemogelDesc: Drain every spendable unit of hemogel from this network's reserve.
LanguageData.FB_DevNetworkHemogelFilled: Dev: {0} hemogel was added to the network.
LanguageData.FB_DevNetworkHemogelDrained: Dev: {0} hemogel was drained from the network.
LanguageData.FB_WorldStorageNoMatches: No stored items match the search.
LanguageData.FB_WorldStorageRowHint: Click selects the item; Shift+click selects the range from the previous selection. Checkboxes can be ticked by dragging the mouse.
LanguageData.FB_WorldStorageSendSelectedDesc: Send the selected items up the umbilicus to the Moon, or by supply caravan to another flesh outpost.
LanguageData.FB_WorldStorageDigestSelectedDesc: Digest the selected items that contain nutrition right in storage. The hemogel goes straight into the network's shared reserve at {0} per point of nutrition, the same yield as a Colony Stomach. Items without nutrition are left alone, and gear from corpses stays in storage.
LanguageData.FB_WorldStorageDigestSelectedStats: Items to digest: {0} (+{1} hemogel) Free reserve space: {2}
LanguageData.FB_WorldStorageDigestConfirm: Digest the selected items ({0})? Up to {1} hemogel goes into the network reserve, and the items are gone for good.
LanguageData.FB_WorldStorageDigested: Items digested: {0}. {1} hemogel went into the network reserve.
LanguageData.FB_WorldStorageDigestReserveFull: The network reserve ran out of room: some of the selected items stayed in storage.
LanguageData.FB_WorldStorageDigestNoRoom: The network reserve has no room for more hemogel.
LanguageData.FB_WorldStorageDigestNoNetwork: This storage is not connected to a hemogel network.
LanguageData.FB_WorldStorageDeleteSelectedDesc: Destroy all selected items. They cannot be recovered.
LanguageData.FB_WorldStorageDeleteSelectedConfirm: Delete the selected items ({0}) from storage? They are lost for good.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkAttackSettlementDesc: Choose fleshbeasts from the garrison and send them to a humanlike settlement. Attacking a non-hostile faction makes it hostile. On arrival, fight the battle yourself or let the pack resolve it.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkAssaultRequiresHostil: Choose a humanlike settlement whose location is not open and which is not tied to an active quest.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkAssaultSettlementQues: This settlement is tied to an active quest and cannot be assaulted.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkAssaultRelationsLocke: Relations with {0} cannot be worsened right now, so they cannot be attacked.
LanguageData.FB_PlanetaryNetworkAssaultSettlementLoad: This settlement's location is currently open. Leave it before sending a new assault party.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultInspectCarrying: Returning to: {0} Beasts: {1} Cargo: {2} stack(s), {3} / {4} kg
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultVictoryText: The flesh assault party destroyed {0} in an automatically resolved battle. Beasts returning home: {1}, lost in the fight: {2}.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultDefeatedText: The flesh assault party failed to break {0}. Strength {1} was below the calculated difficulty {2}, and the committed hemogel was lost.
LanguageData.FB_FleshAssaultInvalidTargetText: The settlement on world tile {0} is no longer available for attack. The assault party is returning.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyCaravanCommandDesc: Grow enough fingerspikes, trispikes and bulbfreaks to carry all of the camp's loot, then send them to the selected flesh outpost. Right-click the button to toggle automatic dispatch: every {0}, the camp sends its loot along its delivery route, or to the nearest outpost connected to it by veins if no route is set.
LanguageData.FB_FleshOutpostCaravanCommandDesc: Grow enough fingerspikes, trispikes and bulbfreaks to carry the contents of this outpost's storage, then send them to another flesh outpost. Right-click the button to toggle automatic forwarding: every {0}, the stored goods travel along the delivery route. Forwarding does nothing without a route.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyCaravanNoCargo: There is no stored cargo to carry.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyCaravanNoOutpost: No flesh outpost is connected to this camp, so the loot stays in its storage.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyCaravanRequiresOutpost: Choose one of your flesh outposts as the delivery target.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyCaravanLaunched: A supply caravan of {0} beast(s) set out with {1} stack(s) of cargo for {2}.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyCaravanArrived: A supply caravan delivered {0} stack(s) of loot to {2}. Its {1} carrier(s) dissolved into the outpost.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyCaravanReturned: The supply caravan came back and unloaded {0} stack(s) into the storage it left from.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyCaravanRerouted: The supply caravan lost its destination and is hauling the cargo back to tile {0}.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyCaravanLost: A supply caravan had nowhere to unload and {0} stack(s) of loot were lost.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyCaravanInspect: Hauling loot to tile {0} Beasts: {1} Cargo: {2} stack(s), {3} / {4} kg
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyCaravanInspectReturning: Returning to tile {0} Beasts: {1} Cargo: {2} stack(s), {3} / {4} kg
LanguageData.FB_FleshBeastCaravanLaunched: A caravan carrying {0} beast(s) set out for {1}.
LanguageData.FB_FleshBeastCaravanReturned: The caravan brought {0} beast(s) back to the outpost it left from.
LanguageData.FB_FleshBeastCaravanLost: A caravan had nowhere to arrive and {0} beast(s) were lost.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyRouteCommandDescCamp:
Choose the flesh outpost that receives this camp's automatic supply caravans. Current route: {0}.
Click the camp itself to reset the route to the nearest outpost connected by veins.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyRouteCommandDescOutpost:
Choose the flesh outpost this outpost forwards its stored goods to. Automatic forwarding is toggled with a right-click on the supply caravan button. Current route: {0}.
Click this outpost itself to clear the route.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyRouteResetTooltip: Reset the route to the nearest connected outpost
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyRouteReset: {0} sends its supply caravans to the nearest connected outpost again.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyRouteCleared: The delivery route of {0} was cleared, and automatic forwarding is off.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyRouteLoop: This route would close a loop, and the cargo would circle forever.
LanguageData.FB_FleshSupplyRouteMissing: Set a delivery route for this outpost first.
LanguageData.FB_FleshCrustCorerDepleted: {0} on tile {1} has drained its tile dry and stopped producing ore. Absorb it and grow a new one on a living tile.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldGrowDesc: Pick a world tile and grow the far maw of this tunnel into it. Cost: {0} hemogel per tile of distance, paid from this network. While the tunnel stands, caravans cross it instantly and flesh war parties reroute through it whenever that is faster.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldGrowStarted: The tunnel node has begun growing a passage to world tile {0}. The far maw will emerge in {1}.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldGrown: A flesh tunnel maw broke through on world tile {0}. Crossing the tunnel is instant.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldGrowFailed: The tunnel could not break through: the target tile is no longer free.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldTargetInvalid: Pick a valid tile on the same planet layer.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldTargetImpassable: The tunnel cannot surface on an impassable tile.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldCollapseDesc: Collapse the tunnel. The far maw will be destroyed, but the tunnel node will survive and can grow a new passage. Spent hemogel is not refunded.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldCollapseConfirm: Collapse the tunnel? The far maw is lost and the hemogel spent on it is not refunded.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldNoLink: There is no finished flesh tunnel on this tile.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldJumpDesc: Jump the world camera to the other end of this tunnel and select it. While the tunnel is still being bored, this shows the target tile instead.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldDevFinishDesc: Immediately finish boring and break the far maw through, ignoring the remaining growth time.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldCaravanEnterDesc: Instantly send this caravan through the flesh tunnel to world tile {0}.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTunnelWorldCaravanArrived: {0} surfaced from the flesh tunnel on world tile {1}.
